root_cause.what: supabase.from('client_profiles').update({uploaded_documents}).eq('id', userId) runs as the CLIENT; client_profiles has RLS with a SELECT-only policy for clients and an admin-only FOR ALL policy, so the UPDATE matches zero rows
root_cause.why_silent: an UPDATE affecting zero rows is not an error in PostgREST — error is null, so `if (upErr) throw` never fires and the handler returns ok:true
root_cause.misleading_grant: GRANT UPDATE (uploaded_documents) ON client_profiles TO authenticated exists (migration 20260605003212) but a GRANT is not an RLS policy
root_cause.correct_destination: public.documents (migration 20260610185015) already exists with policy doc_all FOR ALL USING/WITH CHECK owner_client_id = auth.uid(), and even backfilled the old jsonb; the three server functions were never moved to it
